'''Cooper's Swoopers''' were a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] operating on [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]] in the town of [[Lumchugger's Hub]]. They were led by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer, [[Cooper Dray]]. During [[Operation Death-Hunter]], they became involved with a Rebel [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] group that was investigating a secret Imperial project. When Cooper was captured by the Empire, the swoop gang aided the Rebels in trying to track down their leader.<ref name="DH" />
